question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The sedative effect of the drugs impairs people’s ability to pay attention and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**concentrate.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• In the given question, the blank will represent a word that would get affected because of the effect of drugs.
 
• **Among the given options, the proper word to use would be "concentrate." **
 
• **'Concentrate' means to focus one's attention or mental effort on a particular task or object. ** (ध्यान देना)
 
 
• **​**​Example: Richa wants to concentrate on her career.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence will be: The sedative effect of drugs impairs people's ability to pay attention and concentrate.

​Hence, the **correct answer will be option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 2, segregate, means to separate or isolate something/someone from others. (अलग)
 
• In option 3, reverberate, means to echo or resound. (गूंजना)
 
• In option 4, dilate, means to expand or widen. (चौड़ा करना)
